headline: Ukraine Introduces Restrictions on Card Transfers Even to Relatives: How Much Money Can Be Sent
summary: Ukraine has introduced restrictions on card transfers, including transfers to relatives. Banks may reject a card transaction under the rules, and the report sets out how much money can be sent.
why: Restrictions on card transfers are capital and payment controls that affect household money flows and banks' transaction processing in Ukraine.
